types.name: Fenrir::CursorMode
types.doc: How the mouse cursor behaves over a window.

values.name: Normal
values.doc: Shown, and free to leave the window.

values.name: Hidden
values.doc: Hidden over the window, and free to leave it.

values.name: Captured
values.doc: Hidden and held in the window; the mouse reports raw relative motion (for mouse look).

types.name: Fenrir::CursorShape
types.doc: Which system cursor is shown over a window. `Hidden` shows none.

values.name: Hand
values.doc: The pointing hand, over a link or button.

values.name: Move
values.doc: The four-way arrows, over something that can be dragged about.

types.name: Fenrir::WindowId
types.doc: Which window an input came from. A plain number chosen by whoever feeds the input (FenrirWindow, which keys its windows by it, or a test); FenrirInput only compares it.

types.name: Fenrir::WindowCloseRequestedEvent
types.doc: A window's close was requested (its close button, or the app asked to quit). With WindowConfig::stopOnMainWindowClose, the main window's request also stops the app; the window itself stays until teardown either way.

types.name: Fenrir::WindowSize
types.doc: A width and a height: in logical units (a window's size) or in pixels (its backbuffer).

types.name: Fenrir::WindowConfig
types.doc: How Window::Install sets up FenrirWindow and the main window it will make.

fields.name: logicalSize
fields.doc: The main window's size in logical units; its pixel size is this times the content scale.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: False makes the main window hidden: for GL tests and offscreen tools. Present on it does nothing.

fields.name: stopOnMainWindowClose
fields.doc: True stops the app (App::Stop) when the main window's close is requested. False leaves it to game code, which reads WindowCloseRequestedEvent (to ask "save before quitting?", say).

fields.name: minimisedFrameSleep
fields.doc: Seconds slept at the end of PreUpdate while no window can be drawn (all minimised).

fields.name: unfocusedFrameSleep
fields.doc: Seconds slept at the end of PreUpdate while no window has the input focus; 0 never sleeps.

fields.name: textInputByDefault
fields.doc: True keeps SDL's text input on in each window, so typing sends TextEvent. A window where an input router claims textInput (ADR-0027) has it on, with the claim's caret, either way; a UI app sets this false.

types.name: Fenrir::WindowResizedEvent
types.doc: A window's logical size, pixel size or content scale changed. Carries the new values.
